benchmark: PP1 Assistive Validation Phase 6A — Grammar & Near-Duplicate Decision Benchmark

benchmark_history.note: Every superseded Phase 6A attempt is preserved as audit history. Only the current corpus version carries an authoritative grammar decision.

superseded.superseded_reason: A repository terminology contract required a wording-only corpus revision after the first holdout; no quality threshold, label, policy, weight, filter, or engine setting changed.

Vocabulary-policy holdout independence was not defensible: the approved term OAuth was justified only by holdout case g6-070 while claiming repository provenance, and no repository file contains that term. Its reported LanguageTool SELECT therefore rests on a policy partly derived from the holdout it was measured on.

Three protocol defects: only clean holdout cases g6-061..g6-070 were replaced, so the already-exposed holdout g6-041..g6-060 and g6-071..g6-080 were reused; the run executed LanguageTool 6.4 instead of the reviewed 6.6 candidate, silently changing the measured engine; and Harper never executed because its pinned dependency was absent, leaving no grammar comparison.
